description.value: A public library in the small community of Logan Lake, part of the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library system. The current 3,708-square-foot building opened in 2013, replacing the original library that had served the community from the local mall since 1975. For touring cyclists passing through this relatively remote Highland Valley community, the library offers free Wi-Fi, public computers, and a comfortable place to rest.

address.value: 130 Chartrand Avenue, Logan Lake, BC V0K 1W0

The library appears active with current programming information and was built in 2013.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A public library in the small, relatively remote community of Logan Lake offering free Wi-Fi and public computers — a valuable rest and connectivity stop for touring cyclists in the Highland Valley area where services are sparse.
